name: Sabud
title: King's Friend and Priest
summary: Sabud was the son of the prophet Nathan and served as a priest and personal advisor to King Solomon. He held the honorable title 'king's friend', which was an important official position at the court of the united kingdom.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among Solomon's officials
keyEvents.description: Sabud is mentioned in the list of King Solomon's most important officials and servants as a priest and king's friend.

keyEvents.title: Son of the Prophet Nathan
keyEvents.description: Sabud was the son of the well-known prophet Nathan, who had served as an advisor to King David and played a crucial role in Solomon's accession to the throne.

keyEvents.title: The Title 'King's Friend'
keyEvents.description: Sabud held the official title 'king's friend', which was a significant political and advisory position at the court during the united kingdom of Israel.

keyEvents.title: Nathan's Role in Solomon's Accession to the Throne
keyEvents.description: Sabud's father Nathan played a central role in ensuring that Solomon was crowned king, laying the foundation for the family's influence at court.
